main_text.l: LX. Collatio Logicæ cum Grammatica ex S. literis. | 597
LXIII. Ars disputandi ex sacris collecta. | 604
LXIV. Iudicium de magia ex S. literis collectum. | 613
EAnt nunc delicati philosophiæ gentilis amatores an
rum profani contemptores, & dicant, nihil philosophiæ
profundioris[?] in sacro isto codice occurrere. Profecto
hæc nostra delineatio abunde satis erit ad illos convince-
ndum, inque viam rectam reducendum. Quòd si linea-
menta ista, quæ ego primus ita duxi, amplificentur, magis
magisque patebit verum esse illud nobis familiare: NON
Quidem sententia hunc triumphum obsigno, Deum pre-
catus, ut verbi sui lucem clementer in his turbis conser-
vet, ad nominis sui gloriam, & animæ salutem, per
Pag. 10. linea 11. hæc desunt subjici verba in med.

page.notes: The line "EAnt" carries a large initial E; read as printed. "profundioris[?]" is doubtful: the word before "in" is partly blotted. "Profopographia" is printed that way. The errata lines are in small, rough type; "med." and "subjici" are read with some doubt. The index page numbers are printed right-aligned after leader-free spacing. No catchword or signature is visible.
